FOSSIL_STONE.name: Fossil Stone
FOSSIL_STONE.desc: A fossil of a Pokémon that lived in prehistoric times

OLD_AMBER.name: Old Amber
OLD_AMBER.desc: The holder gains the FOSSIL type

DAWN_STONE.name: Dawn Stone
DAWN_STONE.desc: The holder gains the PSYCHIC type

WATER_STONE.name: Water Stone
WATER_STONE.desc: The holder gains the WATER type

THUNDER_STONE.name: Thunder Stone
THUNDER_STONE.desc: The holder gains the ELECTRIC type

FIRE_STONE.name: Fire Stone
FIRE_STONE.desc: The holder gains the FIRE type

MOON_STONE.name: Moon Stone
MOON_STONE.desc: The holder gains the FAIRY type

DUSK_STONE.name: Dusk Stone
DUSK_STONE.desc: The holder gains the DARK type

LEAF_STONE.name: Leaf Stone
LEAF_STONE.desc: The holder gains the GRASS type

ICE_STONE.name: Ice Stone
ICE_STONE.desc: The holder gains the ICE type

SOUL_DEW.name: Soul Dew
SOUL_DEW.desc: During combat, the holder gains 5 AP and 5 PP every second

REAPER_CLOTH.name: Reaper Cloth
REAPER_CLOTH.desc: The holder's ability can now critically strike based on CRIT_CHANCE. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.

POKEMONOMICON.name: Pokemonomicon
POKEMONOMICON.desc: When the holder deals SPECIAL, they BURN the target for 3 seconds and reduce its SPE_DEF by 1.

ABILITY_SHIELD.name: Ability Shield
ABILITY_SHIELD.desc: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW receive 20% of their max HP as SHIELD and SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds

POWER_LENS.name: Power Lens
POWER_LENS.desc: The amount of SPECIAL blocked by SPE_DEF is inflicted back to the attacker

SHELL_BELL.name: Shell Bell
SHELL_BELL.desc: Holder heals for 33% of all damages inflicted

HEAVY_DUTY_BOOTS.name: Heavy-Duty Boots
HEAVY_DUTY_BOOTS.desc: Holder is immune to any BOARD_EFFECT, forced displacement and LOCKED

AQUA_EGG.name: Aqua Egg
AQUA_EGG.desc: The holder regains 20% of its max PP after casting its ability, + 2 PP for each cast done in the fight

BLUE_ORB.name: Blue Orb
BLUE_ORB.desc: Every 3 attacks, unleashes a chain lightning that bounces to the 2 closest enemies, dealing 10 SPECIAL and burning 15 PP

SCOPE_LENS.name: Scope Lens
SCOPE_LENS.desc: Critical attacks steal 10 PP from the target ON_HIT.

STAR_DUST.name: Star Dust
STAR_DUST.desc: After casting ability, gain 50% of max PP as SHIELD

GREEN_ORB.name: Green Orb
GREEN_ORB.desc: Holder and ADJACENT allies regain 5% of their max HP every 2 seconds. 30% of overheal is converted to PP.

DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.name: Deep Sea Tooth
DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.desc: Holder restore 5 additional PP ON_ATTACK. If the attack knocks out the target, restore 15 additional PP.

SMOKE_BALL.name: Smoke Ball
SMOKE_BALL.desc: Once below 40% max HP, drop the smoke ball, gain 70 SHIELD and jump to a tile away. Every ADJACENT enemy is PARALYSIS and BLINDED for 4 seconds.

XRAY_VISION.name: XRay Vision
XRAY_VISION.desc: Holder is immune to SLEEP and their attacks can no longer miss.

RAZOR_FANG.name: Razor Fang
RAZOR_FANG.desc: Attacks apply ARMOR_BREAK for 2 seconds ON_HIT.

PROTECTIVE_PADS.name: Protective Pads
PROTECTIVE_PADS.desc: Holder deals double damage against units with  SHIELD, and is protected from recoil damage and retaliation effects.

LOADED_DICE.name: Loaded Dice
LOADED_DICE.desc: Attacks have [50,LK]% chance to also hit the lowest health enemy ADJACENT to target for 75% of the damage, which also trigger ON_HIT effects.

PUNCHING_GLOVE.name: Punching Glove
PUNCHING_GLOVE.desc: Attacks deal 8 % of target max HP as additional PHYSICAL ON_HIT

MUSCLE_BAND.name: Muscle Band
MUSCLE_BAND.desc: When the holder takes damage, gain 1 stack. Every 2 stacks, the holder gains +2 DEF, +1 ATK and +5 SPEED (max 20 stacks)

WONDER_BOX.name: Wonder Box
WONDER_BOX.desc: At the beginning of each battle, WONDER_BOX is replaced by 2 temporary random craftable items (max 3 items held)

STICKY_BARB.name: Sticky Barb
STICKY_BARB.desc: When struck by an attack at melee range, deal 3 + 15% of DEF as retaliation TRUE and inflict WOUND for 3 seconds to the attacker.

SAFETY_GOGGLES.name: Safety Goggles
SAFETY_GOGGLES.desc: Holder is immune to all negative status effects and to sandstorm damage

KINGS_ROCK.name: King's Rock
KINGS_ROCK.desc: +100 HP. 20% of max HP are gained as SHIELD when combat begins.

SHINY_CHARM.name: Shiny Charm
SHINY_CHARM.desc: Prevents damage and give PROTECT for 1.5 seconds and 50 PP the first time the holder gets below 30% HP

GRACIDEA_FLOWER.name: Gracidea Flower
GRACIDEA_FLOWER.desc: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW gain +20 SPEED

FLAME_ORB.name: Flame Orb
FLAME_ORB.desc: Holder increases its BASE ATK by 100% and is immune to FREEZE, but suffers from BURN during the entire fight.

ASSAULT_VEST.name: Assault Vest
ASSAULT_VEST.desc: +40 SPE_DEF. Reduce BURN and POISONED damage by 50%

AMULET_COIN.name: Amulet Coin
AMULET_COIN.desc:
+1 GOLD each time the holder knocks out an opponent.
Reduce max interest cap by 10 GOLD.

POKE_DOLL.name: Poke Doll
POKE_DOLL.desc: Reduce all incoming PHYSICAL and SPECIAL by 30%. Makes the holder more likely to be targeted.

RED_ORB.name: Red Orb
RED_ORB.desc: 25% of attack damage is dealt as TRUE

MAX_REVIVE.name: Max Revive
MAX_REVIVE.desc: Give RESURRECTION, preventing the holder first KO and restoring to max HP

ROCKY_HELMET.name: Rocky Helmet
ROCKY_HELMET.desc: +25 DEF. Negates critical bonus damage from all incoming critical hits.

AGUAV_BERRY.name: Aguav Berry
AGUAV_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, restore 50% HP and get CONFUSION for 3 seconds

APICOT_BERRY.name: Apicot Berry
APICOT_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 20 SPE_DEF

ASPEAR_BERRY.name: Aspear Berry
ASPEAR_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being FREEZE, heal 50 HP and give +15 SPEED and immunity to FREEZE for the rest of the fight

BABIRI_BERRY.name: Babiri Berry
BABIRI_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after receiving a critical hit, heal 50 HP and gain PROTECT for 2 seconds

CHERI_BERRY.name: Cheri Berry
CHERI_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being PARALYSIS, heal 50 HP and give +10 ATK and immunity to PARALYSIS for the rest of the fight

CHESTO_BERRY.name: Chesto Berry
CHESTO_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being SLEEP, heal 50 HP and give +50 AP and immunity to SLEEP for the rest of the fight

GANLON_BERRY.name: Ganlon Berry
GANLON_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 20 DEF

JABOCA_BERRY.name: Jaboca Berry
JABOCA_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast Spiky Shield for 10 seconds

LANSAT_BERRY.name: Lansat Berry
LANSAT_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50% CRIT_CHANCE

LEPPA_BERRY.name: Leppa Berry
LEPPA_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after casting ability, heal 50 HP and gain 50 PP

LIECHI_BERRY.name: Liechi Berry
LIECHI_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 15 ATK

LUM_BERRY.name: Lum Berry
LUM_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP, clear negative status and get SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds

ORAN_BERRY.name: Oran Berry
ORAN_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 80 SHIELD

PECHA_BERRY.name: Pecha Berry
PECHA_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being POISONED, heal 100 HP and give immunity to POISONED for the rest of the fight

PERSIM_BERRY.name: Persim Berry
PERSIM_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being CONFUSION, heal 50 HP and give 10 SPE_DEF and immunity to CONFUSION for the rest of the fight

PETAYA_BERRY.name: Petaya Berry
PETAYA_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 80 AP

RAWST_BERRY.name: Rawst Berry
RAWST_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being BURN, heal 50 HP and give 10 DEF and immunity to BURN for the rest of the fight

ROWAP_BERRY.name: Rowap Berry
ROWAP_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast Magic Bounce for 10 seconds

SALAC_BERRY.name: Salac Berry
SALAC_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50 SPEED

SITRUS_BERRY.name: Sitrus Berry
SITRUS_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 100 HP and increase all healing received by 30%

GOLDEN_RAZZ_BERRY.name: Golden Razz Berry
GOLDEN_RAZZ_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 6 free shop rerolls.

GOLDEN_NANAB_BERRY.name: Golden Nanab Berry
GOLDEN_NANAB_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 5 GOLD.

GOLDEN_PINAP_BERRY.name: Golden Pinap Berry
GOLDEN_PINAP_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 3 random SWEETS.

COMFEY.name: Comfey
COMFEY.desc: Wears Comfey and get its ability and its max HP, ATK, DEF, and SPE_DEF as bonus stats.

ELECTIRIZER.name: Electirizer
ELECTIRIZER.desc: Gives ELECTRIC synergy. Every third attack inflicts PARALYSIS for 2 seconds ON_HIT.

MAGMARIZER.name: Magmarizer
MAGMARIZER.desc: Gives FIRE synergy. The holder doesn't take BURN damage. Instead, it gains 30 SPEED when burning.

DRAGON_SCALE.name: Dragon Scale
DRAGON_SCALE.desc: Gives DRAGON synergy as first synergy.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.desc: Gives SOUND synergy. Every second, the holder gains 5 PP.

EXPLORER_KIT.name: Explorer Kit
EXPLORER_KIT.desc: Gives GROUND synergy. Increase the [LK] chance to find gold buried in the ground.

AIR_BALLOON.name: Air Balloon
AIR_BALLOON.desc: Gives FLYING synergy. Gain 10% chance to dodge attacks and immunity to any BOARD_EFFECT.

INCENSE.name: Incense
INCENSE.desc: Gives FLORA synergy. Each Pokémon in shop has an additional 5% chance to share a common synergy with the holder.

EXP_SHARE.name: Exp. Share
EXP_SHARE.desc: Get the best ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF values of allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW.

TERRAIN_EXTENDER.name: Terrain Extender
TERRAIN_EXTENDER.desc: At the start of the fight, holder gains either ELECTRIC_FIELD, GRASS_FIELD, PSYCHIC_FIELD or FAIRY_FIELD based on its synergies. When casting its ability, spread the field effect to all allies sharing the field's synergy.

POKERUS_VIAL.name: Pokérus Vial
POKERUS_VIAL.desc: Gives POISON synergy. Infects the holder with POKERUS, gaining 1 ATK and 10 AP every 3 seconds and transmitting to ADJACENT allies.

SPELL_TAG.name: Spell Tag
SPELL_TAG.desc: Gives GHOST synergy. When the holder is KO, CURSE its attacker to be KO'd after 10 seconds

SHED_SHELL.name: Shed Shell
SHED_SHELL.desc: Gives BUG synergy but reduce the holder's max HP by 50% when cloned.

BERSERK_GENE.name: Berserk Gene
BERSERK_GENE.desc: Gives MONSTER synergy. The holder gets CONFUSION for 1 second if gaining MONSTER stacks.

SURFBOARD.name: Surf Board
SURFBOARD.desc: Gives AQUATIC synergy. The holder casts Surf at every TIDAL_WAVE, with the ability level matching current AQUATIC synergy level.

COOKING_POT.name: Cooking Pot
COOKING_POT.desc: Gives GOURMET synergy. When BURN, the COOKING_POT is heated little by little which gives 10 SPEED per second.

RUNNING_SHOES.name: Running Shoes
RUNNING_SHOES.desc: Gives FIELD synergy. The holder gains 5 SPEED every tile they move (jumps and dashes count for one tile).

MAX_ELIXIR.name: Max Elixir
MAX_ELIXIR.desc: Restores 100% of max PP 1 second after the first ability cast.

METEORITE.name: Meteorite
METEORITE.desc: A meteorite that seems to interact with Deoxys. It continues to give off a faint glow and is slightly warm to the touch.

ROTOM_CATALOG.name: Rotom Catalog
ROTOM_CATALOG.desc: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

TRASH.name: Trash
TRASH.desc: No effect, but can be held.

DYNAMAX_BAND.name: Dynamax Band
DYNAMAX_BAND.desc: At the start of the fight, raise max HP by 200%.

SHINY_STONE.name: Shiny Stone
SHINY_STONE.desc: Gives LIGHT synergy. A second spotlight is projected onto the holder's tile at the start of the fight.

OLD_ROD.name: Old Rod
OLD_ROD.desc: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch common and uncommon WATER Pokémon as well as Magikarp.

GOOD_ROD.name: Good Rod
GOOD_ROD.desc: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch rare WATER Pokémon as well as Feebas.

SUPER_ROD.name: Super Rod
SUPER_ROD.desc: After each PvP round, fish a Pokémon that is then added to a free slot on your bench. Can catch epic WATER Pokémon as well as Wishiwashi.

RARE_CANDY.name: Rare Candy
RARE_CANDY.desc: Immediately make a Pokémon evolve. Can only be given to Pokémon that can evolve, and reduce its sell price to its previous tier.

EVIOLITE.name: Eviolite
EVIOLITE.desc: Holder gets a bunch of stats, but can no longer evolve. Can only be given to non-fully evolved Pokémon.

RED_SCALE.name: Red Scale
RED_SCALE.desc: Increase your passive income by 5 GOLD per round

GOLD_MASK.name: Gold Mask
GOLD_MASK.desc: At the start of the fight, spawn 3 Pokémon that share a type with the holder. Rarity and tier scale with stage level.

GOLD_BOTTLE_CAP.name: Gold Bottle Cap
GOLD_BOTTLE_CAP.desc: +1% CRIT_POWER per GOLD you have. Gain 1 GOLD per KO. If eliminating the last enemy, get a Jackpot that doubles the amount gained during the round.

ABSORB_BULB.name: Absorb Bulb
ABSORB_BULB.desc: All the damage reduction is absorbed by the bulb. Once under 50% HP, bulb explodes, dealing all damage absorbed to ADJACENT enemy units as SPECIAL.

SACRED_ASH.name: Sacred Ash
SACRED_ASH.desc: Gives RESURRECTION. After resurrecting, up to 3 allies KO are resurrected as well, but without items.

STAR_PIECE.name: Star Piece
STAR_PIECE.desc: Gives the holder one additional STAR, which increases the power of their ability.

REPEAT_BALL.name: Repeat Ball
REPEAT_BALL.desc: Each time you spend gold on a reroll, gain 1 free reroll. For every 2 shop rerolls, gain 1 SPEED and 2 SHIELD. After lots of rerolls, you may encounter powerful Pokémon in your shop.

GOLD_BOW.name: Gold Bow
GOLD_BOW.desc: The holder does not count for team size limit.

DAMP_ROCK.name: Damp Rock
DAMP_ROCK.desc: Counts for 3 towards RAIN. Under RAIN, your team gains +2 PP per second.

ICY_ROCK.name: Icy Rock
ICY_ROCK.desc: Counts for 3 towards SNOW. Under SNOW, your team recovers from FREEZE 20% faster and have [5,LK]% additional chance to FREEZE their opponents with their attacks.

HEAT_ROCK.name: Heat Rock
HEAT_ROCK.desc: Counts for 3 towards DROUGHT. Under DROUGHT, your team gains 3 ATK and takes 20% less damage from BURN.

SMOOTH_ROCK.name: Smooth Rock
SMOOTH_ROCK.desc: Counts for 3 towards SANDSTORM. Under SANDSTORM, your team takes 20% less sandstorm damage and gain 1 SPEED every second.

BLACK_AUGURITE.name: Black Augurite
BLACK_AUGURITE.desc: Counts for 3 towards NIGHT. Under NIGHT, your team gains 5% CRIT_CHANCE and take 10% less critical damage.

FLOAT_STONE.name: Float Stone
FLOAT_STONE.desc: Counts for 3 towards WINDY. Under WINDY, your team gains 10 SPEED.

MIST_STONE.name: Mist Stone
MIST_STONE.desc: Counts for 3 towards MISTY. Under MISTY, your team gains 3 SPE_DEF.

ELECTRIC_QUARTZ.name: Electric Quartz
ELECTRIC_QUARTZ.desc: Counts for 3 towards STORM. Under STORM, your team gains 50 SHIELD when struck by lightning and recovers from PARALYSIS 20% faster.

BLOOD_STONE.name: Blood Stone
BLOOD_STONE.desc: Counts for 3 towards BLOODMOON. Under BLOODMOON, your team gets 30% of incoming healing as SHIELD when WOUND, and heal for 20% of damage dealt if target is WOUND.

SMELLY_CLAY.name: Smelly Clay
SMELLY_CLAY.desc: Counts for 3 towards SMOG. Under SMOG, your team gains 5% accuracy and has 15% less chance to get POISONED.

ODD_KEYSTONE.name: Odd Stone
ODD_KEYSTONE.desc: Counts for 3 towards MURKY. Under MURKY, your team gains 10 LUCK and -10% negative status duration, and resist to CURSE 1 second longer.

SUN_STONE.name: Sun Stone
SUN_STONE.desc: Counts for 3 towards ZENITH. Under ZENITH, your Pokémon heal for 5 HP every 2 seconds and have 5% additional chance to BURN with their attacks.

FIRE_SHARD.name: Fire Shard
FIRE_SHARD.desc: Sacrifice 3 player HP (1 in Double Up) to give permanently +3 ATK and +3 SPEED to a FIRE Pokémon. Immediately consumed when given.

TEAL_MASK.name: Teal Mask
TEAL_MASK.desc: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the FLORA type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.

WELLSPRING_MASK.name: Wellspring Mask
WELLSPRING_MASK.desc: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the AQUATIC type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.

CORNERSTONE_MASK.name: Cornerstone Mask
CORNERSTONE_MASK.desc: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the ROCK type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.

HEARTHFLAME_MASK.name: Hearthflame Mask
HEARTHFLAME_MASK.desc: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the FIRE type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.

ZYGARDE_CUBE.name: Zygarde Cube
ZYGARDE_CUBE.desc: Contains cells of the Order Pokémon, Zygarde. It will cause a transformation into one of its alternate formes.

TM_RAGE.name: TM01 - Rage
TM_RAGE.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Rage: Get RAGE status for 3 seconds and gain [10,10,10,20,SP]% BASE ATK for each 10% of max HP missing

TM_RETURN.name: TM02 - Return
TM_RETURN.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Return: Deal [20,40,80,160,SP] SPECIAL to the target, then gain 2 AP permanently.

TM_COUNTER.name: TM03 - Counter
TM_COUNTER.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Counter: The user lashes out at ADJACENT enemy Pokémon dealing [50,50,50,100,SP]% of its missing HP as SPECIAL.

TM_DISABLE.name: TM04 - Disable
TM_DISABLE.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Disable: Deal [12,25,50,100,SP] SPECIAL to the target and all ADJACENT enemy Pokémon and SILENCE them for [2,3,4,8] seconds.

TM_BULK_UP.name: TM05 - Bulk Up
TM_BULK_UP.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Bulk Up: Increase BASE ATK and BASE DEF by [50,50,50,100,SP]%

TM_CHARGE.name: TM06 - Charge
TM_CHARGE.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Charge: Until the end of the fight, attacks deal [100,100,100,200,SP]% additional SPECIAL (stackable).

TM_REFLECT.name: TM07 - Reflect
TM_REFLECT.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Reflect: For [3,3,3,5] seconds, whenever the user received PHYSICAL, block the damage and reflect [50,75,100,150,SP]% of the damage as SPECIAL to the attacker.

TM_PAYDAY.name: TM08 - Pay Day
TM_PAYDAY.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Pay Day: Deals [15,30,60,120] + [15,30,60,120,SP] SPECIAL. If the target is KO'd, the allied player receives [1,2,3] GOLD.

TM_FOCUS_PUNCH.name: TM09 - Focus Punch
TM_FOCUS_PUNCH.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Focus Punch: Focuses its energy into a single punch, rushing towards the target after 1 second, dealing [500,500,500,1000,SP]% of ATK as SPECIAL and pushing it back. Target is ejected from the board if it does not collide with any other unit.

TM_HYPER_BEAM.name: TM10 - Hyper Beam
TM_HYPER_BEAM.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Hyper Beam: Concentrates its energy for 1 second then fires a powerful beam that deals [65,130,250,500,SP] SPECIAL to enemies in a line. Then user gets FATIGUE for 5 seconds.

TM_SUBSTITUTE.name: TM11 - Substitute
TM_SUBSTITUTE.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Substitute: Spawns a Substitute at the location of the user with [25,25,25,50,SP]% of user's max HP as bonus HP. The user moves to a free cell nearby and all aggro is redirected to the Substitute.

TM_SKILL_SWAP.name: TM12 - Skill Swap
TM_SKILL_SWAP.desc:
Teaches a HUMAN Pokémon a new ability and set its max PP to 100. Can only be used once.
Skill Swap: Copy the ability and max PP of the target if not INIMITABLE, then cast it immediately. The copied ability persists between fights and can be reset by benching the user.

CHEF_HAT.name: Chef's Hat
CHEF_HAT.desc: The holder will cook their Signature Dish between rounds.

PICNIC_SET.name: Picnic Set
PICNIC_SET.desc: Immediately consumed when given. Give a SANDWICH to the holder and all ADJACENT allies. SANDWICH gives stat boosts for the next fight based on the types of the Pokémon eating it.

SANDWICH.name: Sandwich
SANDWICH.desc: Gives various stat boosts for the next fight based on the types of the Pokémon eating it.

HEARTY_STEW.name: Hearty Stew
HEARTY_STEW.desc: At the start of next fight, raise max HP by 30%. If fed to a Pokémon holding COOKING_POT, the Pokémon is BURN for 5 seconds.

RAGE_CANDY_BAR.name: Rage Candy Bar
RAGE_CANDY_BAR.desc: Gain 10 ATK at the start of the next fight.

TEA.name: Tea
TEA.desc: Gain 60 PP at the start of the next fight.

CURRY.name: Curry
CURRY.desc: Start the next fight RAGE for 3 seconds.

CASTELIACONE.name: Casteliacone
CASTELIACONE.desc: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict FREEZE for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always FREEZE.

WHIPPED_DREAM.name: Whipped Dream
WHIPPED_DREAM.desc: In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict CHARM for 2 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always CHARM.

BERRY_JUICE.name: Berry Juice
BERRY_JUICE.desc: Gain 100 SHIELD at the start of the next fight and every time a berry is consumed.

NANAB_BERRY.name: Nanab Berry
NANAB_BERRY.desc: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and player gains 1 GOLD.

OLIVE_OIL.name: Olive Oil
OLIVE_OIL.desc: Gain 20% dodge chance in the next fight.

TART_APPLE.name: Tart Apple
TART_APPLE.desc: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon will remove 2 DEF from the target. Will turn into a SWEET_APPLE after one round.

SWEET_APPLE.name: Sweet Apple
SWEET_APPLE.desc: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon will remove 2 SPE_DEF from the target. Will turn into a SIRUPY_APPLE after one round.

SIRUPY_APPLE.name: Syrupy Apple
SIRUPY_APPLE.desc: In the next fight, each attack by this Pokémon has [30,LK]% chance to inflict PARALYSIS for 1 second. Will turn into LEFTOVERS after one round.

HERBA_MYSTICA.name: Herba Mystica
HERBA_MYSTICA.desc:
Gain a field effect based on its flavor. The flavor will be determined by the type of the Pokémon eating it:
FAIRY: HERBA_MYSTICA_SWEET
GRASS: HERBA_MYSTICA_BITTER
ELECTRIC: HERBA_MYSTICA_SOUR
PSYCHIC: HERBA_MYSTICA_SPICY
Others: HERBA_MYSTICA_SALTY

HERBA_MYSTICA_SWEET.name: Herba Mystica (Sweet)
HERBA_MYSTICA_SWEET.desc: Get FAIRY_FIELD during the next fight

HERBA_MYSTICA_SPICY.name: Herba Mystica (Spicy)
HERBA_MYSTICA_SPICY.desc: Get PSYCHIC_FIELD during the next fight

HERBA_MYSTICA_SOUR.name: Herba Mystica (Sour)
HERBA_MYSTICA_SOUR.desc: Get ELECTRIC_FIELD during the next fight

HERBA_MYSTICA_BITTER.name: Herba Mystica (Bitter)
HERBA_MYSTICA_BITTER.desc: Get GRASS_FIELD during the next fight

HERBA_MYSTICA_SALTY.name: Herba Mystica (Salty)
HERBA_MYSTICA_SALTY.desc: Get SAFEGUARD during the next fight

HONEY.name: Honey
HONEY.desc: Each Pokémon in the next shop rerolls this round has an additional 5% chance to share a common synergy with a Pokémon eating HONEY.

MUSHROOMS.name: Mushrooms
MUSHROOMS.desc: A mix of mushrooms that can be sold for GOLD when coming back to town

TINY_MUSHROOM.name: Tiny Mushroom
TINY_MUSHROOM.desc: Gives 30 SPEED and reduce max HP by 30% for the next fight when consumed. Will be sold for 1 GOLD when returning to town.

BIG_MUSHROOM.name: Big Mushroom
BIG_MUSHROOM.desc: Gives +30% max HP for the next fight when consumed. Will be sold for 2 GOLD when returning to town.

BALM_MUSHROOM.name: Balm Mushroom
BALM_MUSHROOM.desc: When consumed, gains SAFEGUARD, 30 SPEED and heals 10% of max HP per second for the next fight. Will be sold for 5 GOLD when returning to town.

RICE.name: Rice
RICE.desc: Gives 50 additional max HP. If a Tatsugiri is on the board, also provides the additional stats given by its form.

BERRIES.name: Berries
BERRIES.desc: Forage a random berry for the Chef to hold. If no free item slots, it goes to your inventory.

POFFIN.name: Poffin
POFFIN.desc: Gain 100 SHIELD. All held berries are added to the poffin. Their effects are applied immediately, with healed HP turned into SHIELD.

ROCK_SALT.name: Rock Salt
ROCK_SALT.desc: Start the next fight with SAFEGUARD for 10 seconds and 20% of max HP as SHIELD.

NUTRITIOUS_EGG.name: Nutritious Egg
NUTRITIOUS_EGG.desc: Start the next fight with +50% BASE ATK, DEF and SPE_DEF.

LEFTOVERS.name: Leftovers
LEFTOVERS.desc: No effect. There is not much left to eat.

BLACK_SLUDGE.name: Black Sludge
BLACK_SLUDGE.desc: POISONED the Pokémon that eats it. If it has POISON type, restore 5% of max HP every 2 seconds instead. In the next fight, get [30,LK]% chance to inflict POISONED for 5 seconds ON_HIT. The first attack always inflicts POISONED.

FRUIT_JUICE.name: Fruit Juice
FRUIT_JUICE.desc: Gain 50 SPEED in the next fight.

LEEK.name: Leek
LEEK.desc: Gain 50% CRIT_CHANCE and allow ability to critically strike in the next fight. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.

LARGE_LEEK.name: Large Leek
LARGE_LEEK.desc: Gain 100% CRIT_POWER and allow ability to critically strike in the next fight. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.

SMOKED_FILET.name: Smoked Fillet
SMOKED_FILET.desc: Permanently lose 5 max HP to gain 3 ATK and 10 AP.

SPINDA_COCKTAIL.name: Spinda's Cocktail
SPINDA_COCKTAIL.desc: A cocktail with [LK] random effects that can buff stats or make you dizzy.

BINDING_MOCHI.name: Binding Mochi
BINDING_MOCHI.desc: The first attack in the next fight will cause POSSESSED for 5 seconds ON_HIT.

SWEETS.name: Sweets
SWEETS.desc: A random candy granting a permanent stats bonus

VANILLA_FLAVOR.name: Vanilla Flavor
VANILLA_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with NORMAL FLYING ARTIFICIAL GOURMET allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Vanilla). Upon casting, the VANILLA_FLAVOR adds [80,SP] SHIELD to the decorated ally

RUBY_FLAVOR.name: Ruby Flavor
RUBY_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with FIGHTING HUMAN STEEL allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Ruby). Upon casting, the RUBY_FLAVOR adds [30,SP] SPEED to the decorated ally

MATCHA_FLAVOR.name: Matcha Flavor
MATCHA_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with GRASS FLORA POISON GHOST allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Matcha). Upon casting, the MATCHA_FLAVOR adds [60,SP] maximum HP to the decorated ally

MINT_FLAVOR.name: Mint Flavor
MINT_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with WATER AQUATIC ICE allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Mint). Upon casting, the MINT_FLAVOR heals [40,SP] HP and adds [15,SP] SPE_DEF to the decorated ally

LEMON_FLAVOR.name: Lemon Flavor
LEMON_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with ELECTRIC BUG FAIRY SOUND allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Lemon). Upon casting, the LEMON_FLAVOR adds [40,SP] % CRIT_CHANCE to the decorated ally

SALTED_FLAVOR.name: Salted Flavor
SALTED_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with ROCK GROUND FOSSIL allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Salted). Upon casting, the SALTED_FLAVOR heals [40,SP] HP and adds [15,SP] DEF to the decorated ally

RUBY_SWIRL_FLAVOR.name: Ruby Swirl Flavor
RUBY_SWIRL_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with FIRE WILD FIELD allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Ruby Swirl). Upon casting, the RUBY_SWIRL_FLAVOR adds [10,SP] ATK to the decorated ally

CARAMEL_SWIRL_FLAVOR.name: Caramel Swirl Flavor
CARAMEL_SWIRL_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with DARK MONSTER DRAGON allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Caramel Swirl). Upon casting, the CARAMEL_SWIRL_FLAVOR adds [80,SP] % CRIT_POWER to the decorated ally

RAINBOW_SWIRL_FLAVOR.name: Rainbow Swirl Flavor
RAINBOW_SWIRL_FLAVOR.desc: Baked with PSYCHIC AMORPHOUS BABY LIGHT allies. Use it on Milcery to evolve into a Alcremie (Rainbow Swirl). Upon casting, the RAINBOW_SWIRL_FLAVOR adds [50,SP] PP to the decorated ally

EGG_FOR_SELL.name: Pokémon Egg
EGG_FOR_SELL.desc: An Egg sold at Chansey's Daycare

COIN.name: Rusty Coin
COIN.desc: An old rusty coin. +1 GOLD when obtained.

NUGGET.name: Nugget
NUGGET.desc: A small gold nugget. +3 GOLD when obtained.

BIG_NUGGET.name: Big Nugget
BIG_NUGGET.desc: A big gold nugget. +10 GOLD when obtained.

GIMMIGHOUL_COIN.name: Gimmighoul Coin
GIMMIGHOUL_COIN.desc:
+5 GOLD when obtained.
Increase max interest cap by 10 GOLD.

EXCHANGE_TICKET.name: Exchange Ticket
EXCHANGE_TICKET.desc: Exchange an item component or a crafted item on bench for another random one. Single use, does not work with scarves.

RECYCLE_TICKET.name: Recycle Ticket
RECYCLE_TICKET.desc: Recycle a crafted item on bench or the crafted items held by a Pokémon into their BASE components. Then all components held are sent back to player item bench. Single use.

TREASURE_BOX.name: Treasure Box
TREASURE_BOX.desc: You wonder what's inside. It will open once you have 40 HP or less.

AUSPICIOUS_ARMOR.name: Auspicious Armor
AUSPICIOUS_ARMOR.desc: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Auspicious wishes live within it.

MALICIOUS_ARMOR.name: Malicious Armor
MALICIOUS_ARMOR.desc: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Malicious will lurks within it.

RUSTED_SWORD.name: Rusted Sword
RUSTED_SWORD.desc: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. Gives the holder +50% BASE ATK. Transfers to the ally with the weakest ATK when the holder faints.

SCROLL_OF_WATERS.name: Scroll of Waters
SCROLL_OF_WATERS.desc: Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of water. When used on a Kubfu, will cause it to evolve into Urshifu (Rapid Strike).

SCROLL_OF_DARKNESS.name: Scroll of Darkness
SCROLL_OF_DARKNESS.desc: Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of darkness. When used on a Kubfu, will cause it to evolve into Urshifu (Single Strike)

MYSTERY_BOX.name: Mystery Box
MYSTERY_BOX.desc: A mysterious old box. When in your inventory, all Ditto found in shops are replaced by Meltan.

RICH_MULCH.name: Rich Mulch
RICH_MULCH.desc: Use it on a flower pot to evolve the Pokémon inside, or on a berry tree to fully grow it.

AMAZE_MULCH.name: Amaze Mulch
AMAZE_MULCH.desc: Use it on a flower pot to permanently give 50 max HP and 30 AP to the Pokémon inside, or on a berry tree to fully grow it and make it golden.

BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET.name: Bronze Dojo Ticket
BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET.desc: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +50 max HP, +5 ATK and +15 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.

SILVER_DOJO_TICKET.name: Silver Dojo Ticket
SILVER_DOJO_TICKET.desc: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +100 max HP, +10 ATK and +30 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.

GOLD_DOJO_TICKET.name: Gold Dojo Ticket
GOLD_DOJO_TICKET.desc: Use it on a Pokémon to send them to the Dojo for 3 stages, returning with +150 max HP, +15 ATK and +45 AP. A substitute takes their place in the meantime.

WANTED_NOTICE.name: Wanted Notice
WANTED_NOTICE.desc:
Wanted: Fainted or Alive
 Reward: 10 GOLD

MEMORY_DISCS.name: Memory Discs
MEMORY_DISCS.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get a previously used type.

FIRE_MEMORY.name: Fire Memory
FIRE_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FIRE type.

FOSSIL_MEMORY.name: Fossil Memory
FOSSIL_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FOSSIL type.

PSYCHIC_MEMORY.name: Psychic Memory
PSYCHIC_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get PSYCHIC type.

WATER_MEMORY.name: Water Memory
WATER_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get WATER type.

ELECTRIC_MEMORY.name: Electric Memory
ELECTRIC_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get ELECTRIC type.

FAIRY_MEMORY.name: Fairy Memory
FAIRY_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FAIRY type.

DARK_MEMORY.name: Dark Memory
DARK_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get DARK type.

GRASS_MEMORY.name: Grass Memory
GRASS_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GRASS type.

ICE_MEMORY.name: Ice Memory
ICE_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get ICE type.

FIGHTING_MEMORY.name: Fighting Memory
FIGHTING_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FIGHTING type.

POISON_MEMORY.name: Poison Memory
POISON_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get POISON type.

SOUND_MEMORY.name: Sound Memory
SOUND_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get SOUND type.

STEEL_MEMORY.name: Steel Memory
STEEL_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get STEEL type.

FLYING_MEMORY.name: Flying Memory
FLYING_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FLYING type.

ROCK_MEMORY.name: Rock Memory
ROCK_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get ROCK type.

GROUND_MEMORY.name: Ground Memory
GROUND_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GROUND type.

FIELD_MEMORY.name: Field Memory
FIELD_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FIELD type.

GHOST_MEMORY.name: Ghost Memory
GHOST_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GHOST type.

LIGHT_MEMORY.name: Light Memory
LIGHT_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get LIGHT type.

NORMAL_MEMORY.name: Normal Memory
NORMAL_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get NORMAL type.

BUG_MEMORY.name: Bug Memory
BUG_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get BUG type.

GOURMET_MEMORY.name: Gourmet Memory
GOURMET_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GOURMET type.

MONSTER_MEMORY.name: Monster Memory
MONSTER_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get MONSTER type.

AQUATIC_MEMORY.name: Aquatic Memory
AQUATIC_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get AQUATIC type.

DRAGON_MEMORY.name: Dragon Memory
DRAGON_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get DRAGON type.

FLORA_MEMORY.name: Flora Memory
FLORA_MEMORY.desc: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FLORA type.

MISSION_ORDER_PINK.name: Mission Order - Evolve!
MISSION_ORDER_PINK.desc:
Complete this mission to earn 30 GOLD:
 get 4 STAR STAR STAR Pokémon on board

MISSION_ORDER_RED.name: Mission Order - Destroy!
MISSION_ORDER_RED.desc:
Complete this mission to earn 30 GOLD:
 inflict 100 damage to other players

MISSION_ORDER_BLUE.name: Mission Order - Level up!
MISSION_ORDER_BLUE.desc:
Complete this mission to earn 30 GOLD:
 reach level 9

MISSION_ORDER_GREEN.name: Mission Order - Diversify!
MISSION_ORDER_GREEN.desc:
Complete this mission to earn 30 GOLD:
 reach 8 different active synergies

MISSION_ORDER_GOLD.name: Mission Order - Prosper!
MISSION_ORDER_GOLD.desc:
Complete this mission to earn 30 GOLD:
 earn 200 GOLD in total during the game

LEADERS_CREST.name: Leader's Crest
LEADERS_CREST.desc: When another player beats you in battle, they get an additional 4 GOLD and take the LEADERS_CREST.

LAPRAS_PASSPORT.name: Lapras Travel Pass
LAPRAS_PASSPORT.desc: Lapras offers a ride to go to a different region. Use the passport on a Pokémon to influence the destination based on its synergies.

CELL_BATTERY.name: Cell Battery
CELL_BATTERY.desc:
Each cell battery on bench gives 2 SPEED to all your ELECTRIC Pokémon.
Use it on an ELECTRIC Pokémon to supercharge it for the next fight, granting it 20 SPEED, 30 SHIELD and ELECTRIC_FIELD.

SILK_SCARF.name: Silk Scarf
SILK_SCARF.desc: Combine it with other item components to make all kinds of scarves, bands and bows. Those items will be removed if you lower down NORMAL synergy level.

FRIEND_BOW.name: Friend Bow
FRIEND_BOW.desc: The holder gains the NORMAL type.

BLACK_BELT.name: Black Belt
BLACK_BELT.desc: Critical attacks provide 33% of the damage dealt as SHIELD.

EXPLOSIVE_BAND.name: Explosive Band
EXPLOSIVE_BAND.desc: The first time user shield is depleted, this item explodes, dealing 50% of all SHIELD gained so far as SPECIAL to ADJACENT enemies.

TWIST_BAND.name: Twist Band
TWIST_BAND.desc: Stat debuffs inflicted by enemies become buffs instead. Holder stat buffs cannot be stolen.

BIG_EATER_BELT.name: Big Eater Belt
BIG_EATER_BELT.desc: Increase all stat buffs received by 25% (rounded down, not affecting PP). Allows the wearer to eat 2 different dishes per round.

LUCKY_RIBBON.name: Lucky Ribbon
LUCKY_RIBBON.desc: Holder gets 20 LUCK and has [15,LK]% chance to dodge attacks.

COVER_BAND.name: Cover Band
COVER_BAND.desc: If an ADJACENT ally is about to get KO with some incoming damage, the wearer takes the damage instead.

EFFICIENT_BANDANNA.name: Efficient Bandanna
EFFICIENT_BANDANNA.desc: The holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW have their max PP reduced by 15%.

NULLIFY_BANDANNA.name: Nullify Bandanna
NULLIFY_BANDANNA.desc: Holder can no longer cast its ability. AP is converted to ATK (5:1), and PP are converted to bonus SPECIAL on next attack.

CONFUSE_WAND.name: Confuse Wand
CONFUSE_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause CONFUSION for 2 seconds and reduce their SPE_DEF by 3.

PETRIFY_WAND.name: Petrify Wand
PETRIFY_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause LOCKED for 2 seconds and reduce their DEF by 3.

SLOW_WAND.name: Slow Wand
SLOW_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause PARALYSIS for 2 seconds and reduce their SPEED by 10.

SLUMBER_WAND.name: Slumber Wand
SLUMBER_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to cause SLEEP for 2 seconds and reduce their ATK by 3.

BLAST_WAND.name: Blast Wand
BLAST_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT, or 50% if it's a critical hit.

HP_SWAP_WAND.name: HP Swap Wand
HP_SWAP_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL has [20,LK]% chance to be stolen from the target's max HP and given to the attacker.

SPIRIT_WAND.name: Spirit Wand
SPIRIT_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT  + 5% for each ability casted by the attacker during the fight, and have [20,LK]% chance to give 5 additional PP.

LONG_WAND.name: Long Wand
LONG_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . Ranged FAIRY allies gain +1 RANGE and have [1,LK]% increased CRIT_CHANCE, multiplied by the distance between attacker and target.

GUIDING_WAND.name: Guiding Wand
GUIDING_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . Wands SPECIAL has [50,LK]% chance to be redirected to the lowest HP% enemy at RANGE.

SURROUND_WAND.name: Surround Wand
SURROUND_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT + 5% per enemy ADJACENT to the attacker. Wands SPECIAL has [10,LK]% chance to be inflicted to all enemies ADJACENT to the attacker in addition to the target.

POUNCE_WAND.name: Pounce Wand
POUNCE_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT . When being hit at melee range, FAIRY allies have [10,LK]% chance to retaliate for 30% of incoming damage to ADJACENT enemies, guaranteed if it's a critical hit.

TWO_EDGED_WAND.name: Two-Edged Wand
TWO_EDGED_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 50% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL can also be inflicted as recoil damage to the attacker ([80,LK]% chance to prevent recoil damage).

WARP_WAND.name: Warp Wand
WARP_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to teleport target on a cell far away

SWITCHER_WAND.name: Switcher Wand
SWITCHER_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to swap target position with farthest enemy

WHIRLWIND_WAND.name: Whirlwind Wand
WHIRLWIND_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT and have [5,LK]% chance to throw a whirlwind that makes all the units in its path to fly away.

TUNNEL_WAND.name: Tunnel Wand
TUNNEL_WAND.desc: Fairy attacks deal 20% ATK as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT. Wands SPECIAL has [5,LK]% chance to pass through the target to hit enemies in a line behind it.

AQUA_MONICA.name: Aqua Monica
AQUA_MONICA.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the WATER type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

FIERY_DRUM.name: Fiery Drum
FIERY_DRUM.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the FIRE type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

GRASS_CORNET.name: Grass Cornet
GRASS_CORNET.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the GRASS type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

ICY_FLUTE.name: Icy Flute
ICY_FLUTE.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the ICE type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

ROCK_HORN.name: Rock Horn
ROCK_HORN.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the ROCK type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

SKY_MELODICA.name: Sky Melodica
SKY_MELODICA.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the FLYING type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

TERRA_CYMBAL.name: Terra Cymbal
TERRA_CYMBAL.desc: Pokémon in the shop are more likely to have the GROUND type (5% bonus chance for each shop slot).

SOOTHE_BELL.name: Soothe Bell
SOOTHE_BELL.desc: Use it on a Pokémon to refresh your shop with Pokémon sharing a type with this Pokémon

BALL.name: Ball
BALL.desc: A ball made of a large hard berry. When casting ability, throws the ball to the furthest FIELD ally to pass them the BALL and 50 SHIELD. If no FIELD ally with a free item slot at sight, throws the ball to the furthest enemy instead, dealing [30,SP]% of user's SPEED as PHYSICAL

BERRIES_GIFT.name: Berries
BERRIES_GIFT.desc: Gift 7 random Berries to your partner.

SWEETS_GIFT.name: Sweets
SWEETS_GIFT.desc: Gift 7 random Sweets to your partner.

DITTO_GIFT.name: Ditto Gift
DITTO_GIFT.desc: Gift a Ditto to your partner. Your partner needs to have at least one free space on the bench.

TICKET_BUNDLE.name: Ticket Bundle
TICKET_BUNDLE.desc: Gift a bundle containing a Exchange Ticket, a Recycle Ticket and a Bronze Dojo Ticket to your partner.

HATCH_BUNDLE.name: Hatch Bundle
HATCH_BUNDLE.desc: Gift 2 random Hatch Pokémon to your partner. 5% chance to receive a Golden Egg instead.

REGIONAL_TOUR.name: Regional Tour
REGIONAL_TOUR.desc: Gift a Lapras Travel Pass to your partner and 10 free shop rolls.

BANQUET.name: Banquet
BANQUET.desc: Give a random dish to every Pokémon on your partner's board and bench. On top of that get one mushroom of each type and a picnic set. Bon appétit!

GEMS_BUNDLE.name: Gems Bundle
GEMS_BUNDLE.desc: Gift 3 random synergy gems to your partner.

POTION.name: Potion
POTION.desc: A potion that heals 10 player HP of the team

COLLECTION_BOX.name: Collection Box
COLLECTION_BOX.desc: Gift 1 SILK_SCARF, 1 random craftable item, 1 random tool, 2 berries and an apple.

PRETTY_BOX.name: Pretty Box
PRETTY_BOX.desc: Gift 2 random completed items to your partner.

DELUXE_BOX.name: Deluxe Box
DELUXE_BOX.desc: Gift 1 random Shiny Item to your partner.

TOOLBOX.name: Toolbox
TOOLBOX.desc: Gift 3 random tools to your partner.

SMALL_EXP_GIFT.name: Small Exp Gift
SMALL_EXP_GIFT.desc: Your partner gains 8 XP. Excess XP at max level is given as GOLD.

LARGE_EXP_GIFT.name: Large Exp Gift
LARGE_EXP_GIFT.desc: Your partner gains 24 XP. Excess XP at max level is given as GOLD.

STAR_GIFT.name: Star Gift
STAR_GIFT.desc: Evolve one random Pokémon from your partner's board. If no Pokémon on the board can evolve, one of them will receive a big stat boost.

COMMON_GIFT.name: Common Gift
COMMON_GIFT.desc: Gift a random 3 STAR Common Pokémon to your partner. It will match your partner's highest active synergy.

UNCOMMON_GIFT.name: Uncommon Gift
UNCOMMON_GIFT.desc: Gift a random 2 STAR Additional or Regional Uncommon Pokémon to your partner. It will match your partner's highest active synergy.

RARE_GIFT.name: Rare Gift
RARE_GIFT.desc: Gift a random 2 STAR Additional or Regional Rare Pokémon to your partner. It will match your partner's highest active synergy.

EPIC_GIFT.name: Epic Gift
EPIC_GIFT.desc: Gift a random 2 STAR Additional or Regional Epic Pokémon to your partner. It will have your partner's highest active synergy.

ULTRA_GIFT.name: Ultra Gift
ULTRA_GIFT.desc: Gift a random 1 STAR Ultra Pokémon to your partner. It will have one of your partner's 2 highest active synergies.

UNIQUE_GIFT.name: Unique Gift
UNIQUE_GIFT.desc: Gift a random Unique Pokémon to your partner. It will have your partner's highest active synergy.

LEGENDARY_GIFT.name: Legendary Gift
LEGENDARY_GIFT.desc: Gift a random Legendary Pokémon to your partner. It will have one of your partner's 2 highest active synergies.

PURPLE_NECTAR.name: Purple Nectar
PURPLE_NECTAR.desc: Can be given to Oricorio to switch to Sensu Style

RED_NECTAR.name: Red Nectar
RED_NECTAR.desc: Can be given to Oricorio to switch to Baile Style

PINK_NECTAR.name: Pink Nectar
PINK_NECTAR.desc: Can be given to Oricorio to switch to Pa'u Style

YELLOW_NECTAR.name: Yellow Nectar
YELLOW_NECTAR.desc: Can be given to Oricorio to switch to Pom Pom Style
